verdict.rationale: The docs show that authorization-time funding requests reach the developer's system for approve/deny decisions under their own business rules, and webhooks deliver events as they occur. Merchant-scoped authorization controls and merchant-filtered transaction retrieval imply merchant identity travels with transactions. None of the specific payload fields in the story are documented. Missing for 10: explicit merchant name and MCC fields on auth events, enhanced merchant data, wallet/tokenization details, entry-mode details, partial-approval signals, incremental-authorization signals, and any hands-on corroboration of payload contents.
